hazards.evidence: A wooden chair is placed in the middle of the kitchen floor between the stove and sink area, narrowing the walking path a walker would need to use.
Upper wall cabinets are the only storage for many kitchen items, requiring reaching overhead which is risky post-surgery.
Open shelving unit on the right holds stacked plates and bowls on very low shelves near floor level, requiring bending down to retrieve items.
Glossy, smooth tile flooring throughout the kitchen near the sink and stove could become slippery, especially if wet, posing a fall risk for someone using a walker.
